purpose: Experiment E-RLT-0117 in the relativity arena: no part of the bound register pair stays behind on a body diagonal, open on the axis (gates fixed before the run): line branches with n . u = 0 would keep 1/4 of the K = 0 line at its energy on a body diagonal and 1/2 on an axis (the same solve reads 0.2500 and 0.5000 on them), and the pair keeps 0 at K 0.20 and 0.24 on the body diagonal, its line moving whole (0.80 and 0.78 of 0.82) by 2 to 3% less than a kappa^2 + b kappa^4; on the axis at 0.24 a neighboring level puts 0.126 there, between the 0.05 and 0.15 bounds.
known_limitations: Depth L2 (L2: known physics reproduced on a stated model).
